ABOUT THE GAME

 The gods are gathered. All twelve are present on Mount Olympus. Zeus is in high spirits, lightning in hand, a magnificent mustache on his face… but—hold on—is that a tail? It seems the King of Gods is looking a little... furrier than usual. A new shapeshift form, perhaps, or has Smokey Le Bandit pulled off his wildest disguise yet?
